## POST `/api/instances/mgmtInterfaceSettings/{id}/action/modify`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Modify mgmt interface settings. It is not allowed to set both IPv4 and IPv6 to Disabled at the same time, in any sequence. It is not allowed to set both IPv4 and IPv6 to Auto in one request. IPv4 or IPv6 may be set to Auto only if the other class IP address already exists, either set as a static IP address or obtained in Auto mode. The Static can be set only implicitly by creating the mgmtInterface object.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Unique instance identifier. This is a singleton resource, so the id is always 0. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `v4ConfigMode` | `InterfaceConfigModeEnum` | Configuration mode of management interfaces. \|Name\|Value\|Description\| \|----------\|----------\|----------\| \|Disabled\|0\|Management access is disabled.\| \|Static\|1\|Management interface address is set… |
| `v6ConfigMode` | `InterfaceConfigModeEnum` | Configuration mode of management interfaces. \|Name\|Value\|Description\| \|----------\|----------\|----------\| \|Disabled\|0\|Management access is disabled.\| \|Static\|1\|Management interface address is set… |

**Responses:** `204` No Content
